title: Seven Winters and One Short Note
subtitle: 挫折振作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：error　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 error 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my father ① made an error that no clerk in the office would have forgiven, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② error, meaning the mistake itself and not the sum, ran seven winters and stayed unforgiven in the book; an error, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unforgiven.

Every ③ error in that office had the same short note beside it, and the ④ error at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the ledger and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An error, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to forgive; my father said the forgiving is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the error was the whole of the lesson, meaning the fault and not the mistake. The ⑥ error, meaning the fault and not any of that, is the only thing in a lesson that everybody waits for and nobody forgives; error, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a mistake and a fault. He said the fault is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ error had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ error of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one office and seven winters of forgiving; error, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to forgive. He said the forgiving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ error I remember is the one forgiven in the report, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the office. An ⑩ error, my mother said in 1970, is the only one that improves by being forgiven; every error, she said, is a fault that has agreed to look like a mistake. She said the fault was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 错误；差错（指办公室里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 错误（指那一处本身，与总数相对）
C. 固定搭配：make an error 犯一个错误
D. n. 错误（指留给账簿的那一处）
E. n. 错误（抽象总称，指一间办公室的出错之事）
F. n. 错误（指报告上写到、被记下的那一处）
G. n. 过失；谬误（指教训里人人都等却无人原谅的那样东西）
H. n. 过失（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人原谅的那样东西）

items.q: made an error that no clerk in the office would have forgiven
The error, meaning the mistake itself and not the sum
the error at the far side
the error was the whole of the lesson
the error had become a line in a report
The error of the whole thing
An error, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: make an error 意为“犯一个错误”，1958 年父亲犯了一个办公室里没有一位办事员肯原谅的错误。
error 意为“错误”，指那一处本身而不是总数，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
error 意为“错误”，指办公室里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
error 意为“错误”，指留给账簿的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
error 意为“过失、谬误”，指教训里人人都等却无人原谅的那样东西，叔叔说这个过失就是那次教训的全部。
error 意为“过失”，指人人都等却无人原谅的那样东西而不是那一处错误，是教训里人人都等、却无人原谅的东西。
error 意为“错误”，指报告上写到、被记下的那一处，到 1964 年这一处成了报告里的一行。
error 意为“错误”，父亲一月写道，整件事的出错之事是一间办公室和七个冬天的原谅。
error 意为“错误”，我记得的是报告上记下的那一处，1968 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一处。
error 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，一处错误是唯一会因为被好好原谅而变得更好的东西。
